title: Once MettleUp Plus limits are on, the Up next screen still shows a free member the suggested weight and reps
what: MettleUp Plus says suggested weight and reps are paid. Inside a workout the free member gets no suggestion and sees a locked line instead. But the Up next screen (Start or Resume a routine) works out the same suggestions and shows each exercise's Target line, the kg to beat and each set's weight with no Plus check at all. So the free member is told the feature is locked in the workout, yet sees it one screen earlier. Today nothing changes, because the limits are switched off.
expected: With the limits on, a free member's Up next screen shows last time's numbers only (or the same locked line as the workout), so the paid part is closed in one rule everywhere.
who: free members, once MettleUp Plus is switched on
fix_line: Give the Up next screen the same suggested-weights check the workout uses

title: When the free month ends, a gym member not yet linked to the gym in the app is only told to buy MettleUp Plus
what: Gym members get every paid feature free, but only once the phone is linked to their gym. At the test gym, no member record has an app link yet (0 of 2). When the free month ends, the one-time pop-up lists what is now paid and offers only 'See MettleUp Plus'. Unlike the '5 days left' pop-up, it drops the line 'You get them free if your gym uses MettleUp' and has no Find my gym button. Most gym members will meet this pop-up before they ever link, and may pay for what their gym already gives them free, or give up on the watch and suggestions. Today nothing changes, because the limits are switched off.
expected: The 'Your free month has ended' pop-up also says gym members get it free and offers Find my gym, as the Plus page does.
who: gym members whose phone is not yet linked to their gym, once Plus is switched on
how_often: once per member, at the end of the free month
fix_line: Add the gym line and a Find my gym button to the free-month-ended pop-up
